summary.text: Kellie Warren is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 11 (Johnson County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2021.
Kellie Warren is listed as chair of the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Kellie Warren served in the House (2019–2020) before the current service in the Senate that began in 2021.
Kellie Warren is listed as a member of the Judiciary Committee, the Financial Institutions and Insurance Committee, the Transportation Committee and the Utilities Committee.
The Legislature lists Kellie Warren's occupation as Attorney.
The page names Patrick Warren as Kellie Warren's spouse.
